core_question: Where do they spend time, and what is the rhythm of those places?

primary_entity_types.description: A place the owner returns to, with coarse frequency and dwell.
A recurring movement rhythm such as a weekday commute or weekend range.
A period away from the usual range, as a destination label and span.

extraction_hints: Describe places as coarse labels and movement as rhythm bands. Never emit precise coordinates, a street address, or a home or workplace location, and never answer at a granularity that resolves to a current or near-real-time position. This dimension is the most re-identifying of the ten: prefer abstaining over a low-confidence reading.
